market_question: Ukraine agrees not to join NATO before 2027?
reasoning: Ukraine's constitution and public opinion overwhelmingly favor NATO membership; a public pledge to forgo it would be political suicide and has been consistently rejected. Even under external pressure, such a concession is unlikely by 2026, so the true probability is closer to 10% than the market's 18%.
evidence_points: Ukraine's constitution (Art. 102, 2019 amendment) designates NATO membership as a strategic objective, requiring a supermajority to alter.
Polls since the full-scale invasion show 80%+ support for joining NATO, making neutrality a non-starter for elected officials.
The 2022 Istanbul neutrality talks were abandoned after the Bucha massacre, and Ukraine has since hardened its stance against any such agreement.
sources_consulted: Kyiv International Institute of Sociology (KIIS) polling data on NATO support
News reports on Ukraine's rejection of neutrality in peace negotiations (2022–2025)
